column1: # XML fact counters (any XML, XSD, XSLT, Spring, Maven): one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex),
# counted over the whole file. The [ignore] lines run first: they blank comments and CDATA sections
# (keeping the line breaks), so a commented-out element does not count. Element and attribute counts
# are regex heuristics over the text, not a parse: a ">" inside an attribute value or an entity is not
# seen. XmlFactPatternsTest pins every case; pom-facts adds the Maven counters.
